title: Automatic Buzz Saw
description: With the &6&3Automatic Buzz Saw&r one can automatically farm trees for their &6Wood&r. If jungle trees are farmed, &6Latex&r automation is also possible.
&3Fans&r, when powered by redstone, can be used to push the dropped items into hoppers or conveyors for storage. Use a &6Drill&r on them to remove the diminishing pushing range.
Press [F1] for more info on applicable items
